Utilizing our breakthrough therapy designation, we requested rolling submission of our BLA in July 2025 and reported in November 2025 that we had completed the BLA submission.

In December 2025, the FDA accepted our BLA for INO-3107 for review under the accelerated approval program as a potential treatment for adults with RRP and set the Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) target date for October 30, 2026.
However, in May 2026, our collaborator ApolloBio Corporation announced positive topline results from their ongoing Phase 3 clinical trial of this candidate in China.
Clinical trials may also be delayed as a result of ambiguous or negative interim results.

For example, as part of the testing process required for BLA submission for INO-3107, we identified a manufacturing issue in the single use administration component of our CELLECTRA 5PSP device, which delayed our ability to commence our confirmatory trial and submit our BLA for INO-3107.
